note: Ten reviewed commands use the shared icon core. Legacy SVGs remain archived as source evidence. Zoom in, Zoom out, Pan and Fit selection were reviewed at 16/24/32 px on Light and Forge in navigation-icon-review.html. Other Pointcloud domain icons retain their original semantics pending visual review. Loading detail and refreshing LOD use Update rather than Fit. The Extensions page uses a separately drawn puzzle piece.

decisions.reason: Opens a point cloud file from the ribbon or project browser.
Exports a scan, mesh or BCF file; the surrounding label supplies the format.
Fits the scene, a section, station poses or a selection in the viewport.
Enlarges the viewport around the pointer; the plus inside the lens distinguishes it from Zoom out.
Reduces viewport scale; the minus inside the same lens distinguishes it from Zoom in.
Moves the viewport without selecting or changing scale.
Frames only the selected objects; the inner dashed selection separates it from Fit all.
